speaker: Wayward Bangaa
line_text: (sigh) I'm about at the end of my rope. I was crossin' the desert makin' for Rabanastre, when a sandstorm hit. Got all turned around. Which way you headed? (choices: Out west. / Back east.) / West, eh? Out to the Yensan Sandsea? That ain't this way. Better turn yourself around. For that matter, maybe you oughta rethink headin' west at all. The sandsea makes the desert look like a sandbox. Easy to lose your way. / If you're goin' east, you must be headed for Rabanastre. I'd love to join you, but I'm too exhausted to think about it right now. I tell ya, I had a time gettin' here. Didn't know where I was or where I was goin'. You get caught in a sandstorm, you be careful. / (sigh) I give up... Tried crossin' the desert again, ended up right back here. I'm thinkin' maybe my sense of direction ain't so good. Maybe I'll talk to that fella over there, see about him takin' me on as an apprentice trader.
